headline: Is TAT Technologies (TATT) Undervalued As Its Honeywell Deal Expands Through 2036?
summary: TAT Technologies (TATT) stock is drawing fresh attention after the company expanded its relationship with Honeywell Aerospace, becoming the sole global authorized distributor of GTCP 331-200/250 APU spare parts and extending MRO licenses to 2036. See our latest analysis for TAT Technologies.
